subject: Banking
title: Nubank: Latin America's Giant
description: Learn Nubank: Latin America's Giant in one minute.

hook.text: Nubank has 90 million customers in Brazil, making it the largest neobank on Earth. It's worth $45 billion.

buildup.text: Brazil's traditional banks charged high fees and offered poor service.

discovery.text: Nubank's cost-to-serve is $0.70 per customer versus $20 at traditional Brazilian banks.

twist.text: Warren Buffett invested $1 billion in Nubank. The world's most traditional investor bet big on digital banking.

climax.text: Nubank proved that digital banking thrives where traditional banking is expensive or absent.

punchline.text: 90 million customers. $0.70 cost per user. Digital banking's biggest success.

quiz.question: How much does it cost Nubank to serve each customer?

details.summary: Nubank grew from a Brazilian startup to Latin America's largest digital bank with over 85 million customers by eliminating fees, using a simple app interface, and targeting the massive unbanked and underbanked population in the region.
details.whyItMatters: Nubank showed that digital banking could succeed in developing markets with poor banking infrastructure. Its success pressured Brazilian banks to reduce the some of the highest fees in the world.
takeaways: Nubank has over 85 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia
It became the most valuable bank in Latin America by market cap
Warren Buffett invested $1 billion in Nubank before its IPO

faq.question: How did Nubank grow so fast in Brazil?
faq.answer: Brazilian banks charged some of the highest fees globally and offered poor customer service. Nubank offered a free credit card with a simple app, no fees, and excellent customer support. Word of mouth drove explosive growth among frustrated consumers.

faq.question: Is Nubank profitable?
faq.answer: Nubank reported its first annual profit in 2023 and has maintained profitability since. Revenue comes from credit card lending, personal loans, and investment products, proving that a digital bank can be profitable at scale in emerging markets.
